newsitem.title: UK: Cantab directors exercise options, sell stock.
newsitem.headline: Cantab directors exercise options, sell stock.

text.p: Three directors of biotech company Cantab Pharmaceuticals Plc, including the finance director, have exercised options and sold shares in the company, Cantab said on Thursday.
Finance director Nicholas Hart exercised 45,000 options at five pence per share and sold 45,000 ordinary shares at 612 pence per share. Hart now has no shares in the company.

Paul Haycock, who stepped down as chief executive on October 1 to become non-executive vice-chariman, exercised 80,000 options at five pence per share and sold 50,000 ordinary shares at 612 pence per share.
Haycock retains 30,000 shares, or 0.2 percent of the company's share capital.

Cantab research director Stephen Inglis exercised 13,360 shares at five pence per share and sold a total of 29,400 shares at 612 pence per share, while his wife sold 1,000 shares at the same price. Inglis now holds 19,960 shares in Cantab, or just over 0.1 percent of its issued share capital

Cambridge-based Cantab, which is developing treatments for genital warts and herpes, said it had also granted an option over 85,079 shares at five pence each to the new chief executive, Jurek Sikorski.
Sikorski's options are excercisable at 630 pence per share between December 12 1999 and December 12 2006.
Cantab said its remuneration committee is seeking approval to distribtue 50,000 ordinary shares to Sikorski, 25,000 shares to Hart and 13,000 to Inglis from 1998.
